sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence and computational pathology》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Data processing and learning has become a spearhead for the advancement of medicine, with pathology and laboratory medicine has no exception.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence and computational pathology》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The incorporation of scientific research through clinical informatics, including genomics, proteomics, bioinformatics, and biostatistics, into clinical practice unlocks innovative approaches for patient care.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】However, computational pathology faces several challenges, including the ability to integrate raw data from different sources, limitation of hardware processing capacity, and a lack of specific training programs, as well as issues on ethics and larger societal acceptable practices that are still solidifying.

evidence.text: The incorporation of scientific research through clinical informatics, including genomics, proteomics, bioinformatics, and biostatistics, into clinical practice unlocks innovative approaches for patient care.

However, computational pathology faces several challenges, including the ability to integrate raw data from different sources, limitation of hardware processing capacity, and a lack of specific training programs, as well as issues on ethics and larger societal acceptable practices that are still solidifying.
